data.name: TransientNetworkErrorRetrying
data.comment: Shown as the task's current step while it waits to re-run after a transient network failure. {0}: seconds to wait, {1}: this retry, {2}: total retries

data.name: DownloadNotices.Summary
data.comment: First line of a task's notes. {0}: number of notices

data.value: …and {0} more (see the log for the full list)
data.comment: Replaces the notices beyond the listed ones. {0}: how many are not listed

data.name: Bilibili.FavoritesNotFound
data.value: Bilibili favorites folder {0} ({1}) was not found in this account. It may have been deleted, or the cookie belongs to another account.
data.comment: {0}: favorites id, {1}: task name

data.name: Bilibili.RiskControl
data.value: Bilibili is temporarily refusing requests (risk control, code {0}). The task retries automatically; if it keeps failing, wait a while or update the cookie.
data.comment: {0}: API code or HTTP status

data.name: Bilibili.RiskControlWaiting
data.value: Bilibili is refusing requests for now (risk control); retrying in {0} min ({1}/{2})
data.comment: Current step while waiting out risk control. {0}: minutes left, {1}: this retry, {2}: total retries

data.name: Bilibili.NotLoggedIn
data.value: The Bilibili cookie is not logged in or has expired. Update it in the downloader settings, then run the task again.
data.comment: The cookie stopped working (e.g. it expired during a run)

data.name: Bilibili.DiskFull
data.value: Not enough free disk space to write {0}. Free up space, then run the task again; downloaded parts are kept and resumed.
data.comment: {0}: the file that could not be written

data.name: Bilibili.SkipNotice
data.comment: One line of a task's notes. {0}: the video (and part), {1}: the reason

data.name: Bilibili.SkipFooter
data.value: Skipped items are not retried automatically, and the log lists every one. To check them again, clear this task's checkpoint.
data.comment: Last line of a Bilibili task's notes
